name: es-irpf-deductions
description: Calculate national IRPF credits for ordinary Spanish residents in 2026 and route regional credits to the right community. Covers startup subscriptions, donations, legacy home investment and rental transitions, business reinvestment, energy improvements, electric vehicles, renewable self-consumption, maternity, childcare and large-family or disability credits, the deduction ledger, the state and regional order of credits, the attributable-tax worksheet, advance-payment reconciliation, deadlines and penalties. The fifteen common-territory regional catalogues, with income gates, eligible bases, sharing, tax limits, holding conditions and authorised carry-forwards, are in one Guide per community (es-irpf-deductions-madrid and the others listed under Rates, bands and thresholds). Use for deducciones autonómicas, maternity deductions, family credits, alquiler, charitable gifts, home improvements, regional investment relief or unused deductions. Distinguishes state-only credits, shared nation
